facts.business: Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd manufactures engineered industrial valves and undertakes project sales for critical process industries such as steel, power, fertilizers, pulp & paper, water, and oil & gas.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Aspiration to reach Rs. 250 crore of revenue by FY 2029–30 through organic and inorganic growth

auditor.name: M/s. Raju & Prasad
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (1) CKP Co-operative Bank balance recovery; (2) DGGI/GST litigation with penalty of Rs. 7.899 crore and Rs. 3.027 crore deposited under protest; (3) Conversion of 5,00,000 warrants into shares at Rs. 200 each, receipt of Rs. 10 crore.

key_risks: Cyclicality and customer concentration in steel and project-linked industries
Competitive pricing, imports, qualification requirements and rapid changes in automation or customer specifications
Raw-material, energy, freight and foreign-exchange volatility
Long approval, inspection and execution cycles delaying billing and collection
Quality failures, warranty claims, safety incidents, cyber events or supply-chain disruptions
